title: Warm Dense Egyptian Rice Tagine
description: A dense and savory Egyptian dish featuring Vialone Nano rice, lardons, and umami flavors, cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is ideal for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the diced lardons over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside, leaving the rendered fat behind.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In the ceramic tagine, combine the cooked onion and garlic, Vialone Nano rice, tomato paste, vegetable broth, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked lardons to the tagine and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 30 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
